label: AC-4(32)
title: Process Requirements for Information Transfer

statement.prose: When transferring information between different security domains, the process that transfers information between filter pipelines:

children.label: (c)
children.prose: Ensures the content associated with the filtering metadata has successfully completed filtering; and

children.label: (d)
children.prose: Transfers the content to the destination filter pipeline.

guidance: The processes transferring information between filter pipelines have minimum complexity and functionality to provide assurance that the processes operate correctly.
